name: Zencare
one_liner: Curated therapist directory with video introductions and vetted providers. $150/month for premium visibility.
short_description: Zencare is a curated therapist directory featuring video introductions, vetted providers, and concierge matching services. Higher price point than Psychology Today with focus on quality over quantity.
long_description: Zencare is a premium therapist directory that differentiates through provider vetting, professional video introductions, and a concierge matching service. Unlike Psychology Today's self-service model, Zencare verifies credentials and requires professional profile content. Each therapist profile includes a welcome video, detailed specialties, and clear pricing. Zencare also offers a free matching service where clients can speak with a care coordinator who recommends therapists based on their needs. The directory focuses on major metro areas. At $150/month, it's more expensive than Psychology Today but aims to deliver higher-quality client matches.

pricing.notes: Premium pricing reflects curation and video production. Metro area focus.

compliance.notes: Directory and matching service for initial client contact.

faqs.a: Zencare provider listings cost $150 per month, which includes video profile production, credential verification, and access to their concierge matching service.

Zencare ($150/mo) is more expensive than Psychology Today ($30/mo) but offers video profiles, provider vetting, and concierge matching. Psychology Today has broader reach; Zencare focuses on quality matches in major metros.
